text:
mira_cs: Quick heads-up — onboarding for HaloScale in 90m. They want a compact 'field kit': a 1-page PM handout and one paste-ready engineer snippet for caching, batching, and streaming. Objective: minimize renewal risk during week 1 if latency or streaming artifacts show up.

raj_csm: I can draft the PM handout. Can we offer three named profiles (guarded / steady / aggressive) with copyable numbers and one sentence tradeoffs for each? PMs prefer pick-and-paste.

elena_sre: Yep. Engineer defaults to copy/paste: guarded: ttl=30s, batch=6; steady: ttl=150s, batch=16; aggressive: ttl=480s, batch=48 (GPU). Streaming chunk=128 tokens. KV cache recommendation: 96MB (mid). Enable warm-pool for first 48h and prefill the top ~25 keys.

elena_sre: Paste-ready JSON snippet for engineers to drop into config:
```json
{"cache":{"strategy":"prefix","kv_mb":96,"ttl_s":150},"batching":{"max_batch_gpu":48,"max_batch_cpu":8,"batch_timeout_ms":20},"streaming":{"chunk_tokens":128,"max_concurrent_streams":10},"slo":{"p95_ms":250,"fallback_sync_after_ms":300}}
```

tom_support: PM handout draft (short & plain):
1) Day0 smoke: run 6 sample prompts end-to-end; confirm partial streaming tokens arrive and model returns responses.
2) Day1 prime: run 8 representative prompts per heavy user to populate KV cache.
3) Day3 check: review p95 latency, error rate, and cache hit% (target >30% by Day3).
4) Day7 renewal check: if p95 >350ms or cache hit <20% escalate to your CSM.

elena_sre: Quick triage commands to include for engineers (copyable):
```
# cache hit ratio (last 48h)
redwoodctl metrics query --customer haloscape --metric cache_hit_ratio --window 48h

# p95 and error rate (24h)
redwoodctl metrics query --customer haloscape --metric p95_latency,error_rate --window 24h

# tail streaming errors (staging)
redwoodctl logs tail --customer haloscape --filter "stream_error" --since 1h
```

raj_csm: Day7 feedback snippet (PM -> Eng) to capture and pipe to CS dashboard: 1) Are outputs meeting expectations? (yes/no + short note) 2) Did you observe any responses >500ms? (yes/no + example) 3) Any streaming breaks or truncated tokens? (yes/no).

onboard-bot: scheduled task: "prefill-top-keys" for haloscape at 2025-06-25T09:00:00Z — status: scheduled :gear:

mira_cs: Owners: Raj = PM handout + handoff email, Elena = infra snippet + troubleshooting notes, Tom = run Day0 smoke and Day3 audit. Ill coordinate the Day7 renewal review with AE. If anyone has edge cases (very short prompts, chatty streaming UIs, heavy token fragmentation) drop them here before EOD. :white_check_mark:
